feeding_claim.verbatim: Our cattle are raised and finished on grass, without a grain-finishing stage.

local_areas: eligible ZIP codes around Fayetteville, Springdale, Rogers and Bentonville
pickup_locations: 2853 N Stanton Avenue, Fayetteville, usually Fridays 4 to 6 p.m.

notes: Category applies to beef. Pork is pasture-raised and the site says the pigs get traditional corn-based feed. Store also lists grass-fed lamb but the site does not say who raises it, so lamb is left out of species. Pork bulk reservations closed until 2027; reserving a December 2026 beef round. Bulk is pickup only. Orders close Thursdays at 11:59 p.m.; local delivery usually Saturday, free on orders of $100 or more.
